data.title: MySQL 0.2.1-rc.1 rebased release candidate
data.description: Review exact c6e915b after rebasing the complete MySQL 8 authentication repair onto remote public-0.2.0 docs commit a311148. Confirm conflict resolution preserves both truthful 0.2.0 public instructions and 0.2.1-rc.1 unpublished state, all auth/security/publisher behavior matches prior approved implementation, exact version/WIT identity, and full just check evidence.

data.reason: Release blocker at exact c6e915bb8b779b49e4582130c6866f08cdfb6d27: scripts/check-live-acceptance.sh pins pre-rebase CANDIDATE_COMMIT cc4dab15d66b760d507fb3214d0b75bb6618a9b6, which is not an ancestor of this rebased tip. The harness exits 1 before service startup (live acceptance workspace does not descend...), so fresh live evidence cannot be ancestry-bound to the reviewed candidate. Update the pin/evidence identity to the rebased candidate and re-run the exact gate. README conflict resolution, auth/security/publisher implementation, just check, actionlint, and reproducible package identities otherwise pass.

LGTM at exact 860c457e5156850fdb5abc3e0e06272d76da55c6. The one-line fix rebinds CANDIDATE_COMMIT to c6e915bb8b779b49e4582130c6866f08cdfb6d27, its direct parent and exact rebased candidate; git merge-base --is-ancestor now passes. Full just check and actionlint pass at this tip, optimized Wasm retains six password-digest wipes, and component/package SHA-256 and BLAKE3 identities remain exact. The README public-0.2.0/unpublished-rc.1 truth and prior auth/security/publisher implementation remain unchanged.
